# openobserve_roles (Data Source)

Lists the custom roles of an OpenObserve organization. Requires OpenObserve Enterprise.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_roles" "all" {}

output "custom_roles" {
  value = data.openobserve_roles.all.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `roles` (List of String) Custom role names.
